camel_example: aliyun esa ListDDoSInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --SiteInstanceId 'esa-site-a71k7bw1adf' --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'esa-ddos-b1e0l80ugfeo' --SortBy CreateTime --SortOrder asc
description_en: Queries the list of additionally purchased DDoS security instances
description_zh: 查询加购DDoS安全实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-ddos-instances --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order asc --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --status online --instance-id esa-ddos-b1e0l80ugfeo --site-instance-id esa-site-a71k7bw1adf --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDDoSInstances

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

CreateTime: purchase time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

CreateTime：新购时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序：

asc：升序。
desc: 降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，第几页，取值大于等于 1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页大小，默认20，最大500，取值：1~500之前的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the associated site plan
parameters.name: site_instance_id

CreateTime.description_en: The purchase time of the instance. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例的新购时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DDoSBurstableDomesticProtection.description_en: The specifications of the DDoS instance in the Chinese mainland

DDoSBurstableOverseasProtection.description_en: The specifications of the DDoS instance outside the Chinese mainland
DDoSBurstableOverseasProtection.description_zh: DDoS实例的非中国大陆规格

ReserveReleaseTime.description_en: The scheduled release time. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
ReserveReleaseTime.description_zh: 预约释放时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

SiteInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the associated site plan instance
SiteInstanceId.description_zh: 关联站点套餐实例 ID

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: The instance is running normally.
offline: The instance has expired but is not overdue, and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released.
overdue: The instance is suspended due to overdue payment
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费停服状态

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
